title: Val Kilmer returns via AI in 'As Deep as the Grave' trailer
key_facts: The first trailer for the indie historical drama 'As Deep as the Grave' was unveiled on Wednesday at CinemaCon in Las Vegas and features a digitally recreated Val Kilmer, who died in 2025 at 65.
Kilmer plays Father Fintan, a Catholic priest; he had been cast years earlier but could not film because of declining health, and production began in 2020 in New Mexico.

With the approval of his estate, including daughter Mercedes, the filmmakers used generative AI and archival material to complete the performance; the estate was compensated and contributed materials.
Director Coerte Voorhees and producer John Voorhees said they followed SAG-AFTRA standards of 'consent, compensation and collaboration', according to the Associated Press.
Kilmer appears on screen for more than an hour, the filmmakers say; no release date has been announced.
The film stars Abigail Lawrie, Tom Felton and Abigail Breslin; Kilmer had himself used AI software to recreate his voice for 'Top Gun: Maverick' after throat cancer.

why_it_matters_hint: A full feature-length AI recreation of a deceased actor, done with the estate's consent and payment, testing Hollywood's new rules.
notes: 6abc's text leans on the Associated Press for the filmmakers' quotes. The trailer was shown 'Wednesday', which from the 4 Oct 2026 publication is 30 Sep 2026, so the event predates the window.
